title: Development and validation of a metabolic syndrome-based nomogram to predict 1-year metastasis after radiotherapy in locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
snippet: Metabolic syndrome (MetS) predicts outcomes in multiple malignancies. This study developed a MetS-integrated nomogram to estimate metastasis within one year after radiotherapy in locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma (LA-NPC), extending existing models and facilitating personalized management.
